basu.translation:
n. (Basu)人名；(英、印)巴苏
abbr. 巴苏（basutoland）

basuco.translation: n. [俚语]巴苏可，劣质(廉价)可卡因

basuto.definition: n the dialect of Sotho spoken by the Basotho; an official language of Lesotho

basutoland.definition: n a landlocked constitutional monarchy in southern Africa; achieved independence from the United Kingdom in 1966
basutoland.translation: 巴苏陀兰(非洲东南部国家莱索托)
